primary_objective: Maximize ARC2 exact Pass@2; scientific research is secondary.

trigger.condition: The bound pipeline terminates, Controller ingests existing evidence, and Governor dispatches the corresponding Director result review.
trigger.window_start: Director activates this request once on that Governor result-review wake, before beginning score-optimization work.

budget.deadline_rule: Persist activated_at_utc and deadline_utc=activated_at_utc+28800 once in the local window receipt. Never reset on retries, Agent handoffs, Governor restart or successor experiments.
budget.launch_rule: Before each new scientific command, verify positive remaining time and existing resource budget. Bound command wall time by remaining time minus closing reserve. Require checkpoint/partial preservation and a bounded termination path. Never start an unbounded detached GPU command.
budget.expiry_rule: Stop new optimization executions, preserve all complete and partial artifacts, and report honestly. No deadline extension without owner approval.
budget.gpu_scope: Routine GPU experiments and engineering retries are authorized inside this single 8-hour window and existing resource budgets, not unlimited additional compute.

branches.rule: Refresh relevant HEADs after the trigger. Preserve active experiment provenance; never switch the running remote checkout or overwrite dirty work to conform to the requested integration branch.

queue.action: Use existing V7+fresh TTT24+canonical AUG8+r4 DFS R1024/R512 evidence on exact 60 tasks / 89 outputs. Do not repeat completed generation or reuse Base TTT weights on V7. Verify raw candidate/node/frontier/probability/cache/adapter identities were frozen before scoring; finish only missing authorized stages under remaining budget.
comparisons: Historical Base D24 union D48 oracle 35/89

queue.action: Use post-freeze outputs and traces to separate model preference, regret pruning, retained-but-unexpanded paths, completion timing, candidate ranking and runtime censoring. Compare matched Base/V7 Gold-token rank/NLL only as nonblind diagnostic. Do not infer task solvability from synthetic scores.

priority_order: Selector improvement on already frozen candidates
DFS frontier ordering and budget allocation
queue.selection_rule: Rank by estimated additional exact solves per GPU-hour; label estimates as hypotheses, not measured gains. Start with CPU-answerable frozen-pool experiments. Avoid already answered or duplicate experiments.
queue.cycle: Hypothesis -> CPU gate -> bounded GPU test only if needed -> raw freeze -> score -> paired FIX/HARM -> KEEP/REJECT -> next highest-return experiment.
queue.validation: Eval60 is exposed development evidence. Never tune on its Gold and claim independent validation. Any promotion requires fresh independent validation; no automatic model promotion.

delegation.Director: Interpret results, select score experiments and allocate the bounded window. Return one stage-scoped decision through Governor.
delegation.Controller: Implement, test, execute bounded commands, preserve artifacts, score only after freeze, and commit/push evidence.
delegation.Governor: Route idempotent handoffs and expose durable task/window references; no scientific interpretation or additional approval layers.
delegation.Supervisor: Monitor registered detached jobs and route mechanical terminal events; no independent experimental relaunch.
delegation.agents: Reuse the existing Director/Controller panes. No new Researcher/Codex Agent layer; direct Herdr messages must not duplicate Governor dispatch or interrupt an actively claimed event.

prohibited: Official competition submission or creation of a new official submission version without owner approval
Public release of restricted research, model weights, secrets or sealed artifacts
Material resource-budget overrun or extending the 8-hour deadline
Gold influencing adaptation, generation, scheduling, ranking freeze or a claimed independent validation
Standalone synthetic LoRA repair, paper-writing or speculative mechanisms unrelated to score
Discarding historical or partial evidence, silent source/checkpoint substitution, duplicate GPU launches
final_report: Best verified Pass@2 and candidate Oracle, with precise cohort scope
Ranked next queue and expected costs
Remaining blockers, verified pushed Git SHA and evidence paths
